FIELDS.NAME: ComfortZone HVAC Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Lead Inspector, ComfortZone HVAC Solutions, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@comfortzonehvac.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ComfortZone HVAC Solutions specializes in providing high-quality residential HVAC services, including installation, maintenance, and repair of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems. Our operations focus on ensuring customer satisfaction through a combination of expert service, licensure of all technicians, and adherence to local and federal regulations, including proper handling of refrigerants in compliance with EPA guidelines. We maintain a robust safety program that includes regular training for our staff on best practices and safety protocols, further reducing risks associated with HVAC operations. Additionally, we employ a CRM system to efficiently coordinate service appointments and ensure timely communication with our clients. With a commitment to operational excellence, we have successfully maintained a history of zero OSHA violations over the past five years, reinforcing our focus on safety and compliance in the HVAC industry.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses have been minimal since the establishment of ComfortZone HVAC Solutions. On December 12, 2022, a minor incident occurred during routine maintenance at a residential property where a small leak was detected in the coolant line, leading to a repair cost of $250. This incident was resolved swiftly without any claims or impacts on our operations. Current status: closed.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $2,500 deductible
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM, Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols and site fencing to deter unauthorized access and enhance safety.
